title: Sessions with error (rate)
sqlTemplate: select count(distinct session_id) as sessions, count(distinct case when type = 'error' then session_id end) as sessions_with_error, case when count(distinct session_id) = 0 then null else count(distinct case when type = 'error' then session_id end) * 1.0 / count(distinct session_id) end as session_error_rate from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}}
emptyDataSemantics: denominator (sessions) = 0 -> session_error_rate is SQL NULL -> NO_DATA, never 0. sessions > 0 and sessions_with_error = 0 -> a real 0.0 rate.
